body.heading: Choose your person
paragraphs: Think of someone who helped you, taught you, or made you laugh. Picture their face.
Decide what you want to thank them for. One clear thing is best.

body.heading: Draw the thank you
paragraphs: Draw the helpful thing happening: the lift, the story, the shared umbrella.
Write or dictate the words thank you, and give your letter away. Giving is the best part.

takeaway: A drawing can say thank you as loudly as any words.
safetyNotes: Give your letter with your adult's help, to someone you know.
screenFreeExtension: Keep a gratitude page and add one small thank-you drawing every week.
